description:
Sacrifice the additional creature to Ashnod's Altar, adding {C}{C}.
Pitiless Plunderer and Kels trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger first, creating a treasure token.
Sacrifice a treasure tokens to pay for Kels' trigger, drawing a card.
Pay {1} for the Nadir Kraken trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Nadir Kraken and creating a 1/1 Tentacle token.
Repeat for infinite card draw.
